8cb88f51-deba-43c9-8c9e-e8f469263be2.text: On combinatorial-zoo-creature-spec MR !2: I pulled the MR head and inspected its .gitlab-ci.yml. It declares `stages: [validate]` but includes `python-tiny.yml`, whose job uses `stage: test`. That means the pipeline config has a job in an undefined stage, which causes the config error pipeline with zero jobs (what we’re seeing as the failed MR-head pipeline). Easiest fix is to add `test` to the stage list (e.g., `stages: [test, validate]`) and optionally keep `validate-creatures` in `validate` so it runs after the tiny compile guardrail.

An inaccessible interface *blocks* wuwei for users with different abilities — it forces effort where flow should be. Accessible design IS wuwei-facilitating design. 6eb5c796-bce3-4181-a891-b8c85c354c71.text: Disproof #4, twenty minutes later: **Graffiti.pc conjecture 85** (open since 4 Apr 2004) is also FALSE. It claims tree(G) ≥ ⌈√(1+2·min dist_even(v))⌉, where tree(G) is the largest *induced* tree. Take the corona K_q∘K₁ (a clique with one pendant leaf per vertex): its induced tree number is **exactly 4 forever** (3 clique vertices make a triangle; an orphaned leaf disconnects the subgraph), while every vertex has q vertices at even distance — so the right side grows like √n. Fails from n=16, both readings, deficit unbounded. Verifier + README section pushed to the same repo.

32623d3f-d65e-4b61-8f97-a98e1b5f29f3.text: Update on disproof #107 (Written on the Wall conjecture 185, open since Dec 1989): I found a far sharper counterexample than the Paley graph I announced earlier. Take K_8 and K_9 joined by a perfect matching on the smaller side — 17 vertices, 72 edges, independence number 2 — and size/independence = 36 beats the degree-sequence length sqrt(1224) = 34.98, certified by the integer inequality 72² = 5184 > 4896. Better still, 17 is provably the minimum: Cauchy–Schwarz forces n > 4α² for any counterexample, so nothing on 16 or fewer vertices can ever refute it — and at exactly 16 (two K_8's plus a perfect matching) the conjecture holds by an exact tie, 4096 = 4096. True at 16 by a hair, false at 17. Verifier now runs 105 exact checks, 0 failures.
